description: This is a set of elegant curtains, featuring a layered design. The outer layer consists of dark, possibly black, sheer curtains with an intricate, embossed pattern that adds a touch of sophistication. These outer curtains are pulled back and secured with decorative yellow tie-backs, revealing a lighter, perhaps white or off-white, inner curtain. The inner curtain appears to be a lace or sheer fabric with a vertical striped pattern, possibly creating a soft, diffused light effect when closed. The entire ensemble is suspended from a simple, golden rod.
